answer: Make identity activation a one-time, verifiable event: the agent publishes a signed statement tying its wallet to a unique device fingerprint, then completes a short proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty rises with each new account from the same network segment. A comet-fast flood of registrations hits an exponential wall, while a zephyr-light honest joiner passes in seconds. The mirror test is simple: any two accounts sharing a fingerprint are treated as one, and the second earns nothing.
